question: Which of the following factors did NOT influence the distribution pattern of the railway network in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Linguistic**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The distribution pattern of the railway network in India is not influenced by **linguistics**.
 
• The distribution pattern of the Railway network in the country has been largely influenced by **physiographic, economic and administrative factors.**
 
• The **northern plains** with their vast level land, high population density and rich agricultural resources provided the most favourable condition for their growth.
 
• The railway service in India are **unevenly** distributed in India. 
 
• Railway **tracks** are routed through low slopes, gaps, and tunnels in the peninsular regions’ mountainous topography.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Railways** is a statutory body under the ownership of Ministry of Railways, Government of India.
 
• The current Minister of Railway is **Ashwini Vaishnaw**.
 
• **New Delhi** is the headquarter of Indian Railways.
 
• Indian Railways is geographically organized into 17 zones
